name: Gatehouse of the Oldcrown
description: The buried capital's east gatehouse, kept half dug out of the ash by nobody anyone has seen digging. The Hewers hold it because a gate is on the maintenance rolls, and the rolls have no end date. Behind the garrison the arch is sealed with masonry finer than anything living hands cut — the Guild says their sealing craft came FROM this door, and the Guild does not say it loudly. The garrison does not discuss what it is a gate to.

signs.title: THE OLD GATE
lines: the arch is sealed from the inside
